review_candidates.title: Senior Database Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company Fruition Executive Search is a premier recruitment firm dedicated to connecting top-tier talent with leading organizations across various industries. With a focus on quality and integrity, Fruition Executive Search specializes in sourcing highly qualified professionals for critical roles that drive organizational success. Our commitment to excellence and personalized service has established us as a trusted partner for both clients and candidates seeking impactful career opportunities. We operate with a deep understanding of market dynamics and maintain a broad network of industry contacts, enabling us to deliver tailored recruitment solutions that meet the unique needs of each client. About The Role We are seeking an experienced Database Engineer to join a mission-critical, geographically distributed system supporting the Intelligence Community. This role demands a highly skilled professional capable of designing, implementing, and maintaining complex data architectures that meet stringent security, performance, and interface requirements. As a key member of the technical team, you will be responsible for managing both relational and non-relational data systems, ensuring data integrity, availability, and security. Your expertise will contribute to the development of scalable, high-performance database solutions that support critical national security objectives. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a minimum of 10+ years of experience as a Database Administrator or Engineer, particularly within similar high-stakes, large-scale programs. A strong foundation in relational databases such as PostgreSQL, along with experience in NoSQL databases like MongoDB and Cassandra, is essential. Proficiency in Java programming is required, serving as a baseline for technical communication and development tasks. Candidates should hold a bachelor’s degree in a relevant technical field or possess equivalent experience, with at least four additional years of DBA experience in lieu of a degree. An active TS/SCI clearance with Full Scope Polygraph is mandatory, with the last polygraph conducted within the past six years. Candidates must have no Counterintelligence Concerns (CCAs). Nice-to-have skills include experience with SAFe or Agile methodologies, as well as familiarity with Cassandra and MongoDB. Responsibilities Design, build, and document relational and non-relational data architectures, ensuring they meet operational and security requirements. Manage data movement at scale, including replication across distributed nodes, ensuring high availability, failover capabilities, and concurrent access management. Optimize database performance through tuning, capacity planning, and proactive issue investigation and resolution. Implement and oversee backup and recovery procedures, ensuring data integrity and availability. Translate schema requirements and raw data into usable structures through ad hoc queries, scripting, and macros. Conduct requirements analysis, risk assessments, and evaluate system-level solutions to ensure optimal performance and security. Define and manage both short-term and long-term database requirements for administration and system design. Collaborate within an Agile team environment, working closely with systems, software, testing, and information assurance engineers. Participate in Program Increment Planning and daily collaboration with technical peers and customer points of contact to ensure project alignment and success. Benefits Fruition Executive Search offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees' health, well-being, and financial security. This includes three weeks of paid time off, over ten paid holidays, and medical/dental coverage options. Additional benefits encompass Short-Term Disability (STD), Long-Term Disability (LTD), Life Insurance, Accidental Death & Dismemberment (AD&D), a 401(k) plan with up to 4% company match, and end-of-year profit sharing. We are committed to fostering a positive work environment that promotes professional growth and work-life balance, ensuring our team members are well-supported throughout their careers. Equal Opportunity Fruition Executive Search is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, ethnicity, religion, sex, national origin, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by law. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all individuals are valued and empowered to contribute to our collective success.

review_candidates.description: Be Challenged and Make a Difference In a world of technology, people make the difference. We believe if we invest in great people, then great things will happen. Our environment is highly containerized, fully automated, and built around Azure services, AKS, Terraform/Terragrunt, and GitOps workflows. US Citizenship with a Public Trust, Secret, or Top Secret clearance and experience supporting the Federal Government is REQUIRED . Implement GitOps with Argo CD and GitHub workflows. Deploy and maintain containerized workloads using Docker, Helm, Kustomize. Manage Azure networking, identity, and security (VNets, Private Link, RBAC, Key Vault). Run Azure data services: PostgreSQL Flexible Server, Service Bus, Redis, AI Search, Storage, ACR. Own reliability: monitoring, alerting, KQL dashboards, incident response, performance tuning. Required Qualifications: Minimum Qualifications (Education/Certications, Experience, etc): Bachelors Degree in a relevant field Five (5) years of hands-on experience cloud platform engineering, SRE, or DevOps roles Experience supporting large, distributed systems within the Federal Government Clearance: Minimum Public Trust; US Citizenship and ability to maintain a High Risk Public Trust designation is required Other Required Skills & Qualifications: Deep hands-on experience with Azure, AKS, and Kubernetes operations. (AWS experience may be considered in lieu of Azure.) Deep hands-on experience with containerization technologies: Docker, Helm, Kustomize. Deep hands-on experience with Terraform, Terragrunt, and modular IaC. Strong GitOps experience with Argo CD and GitHub workflows. Strong experience in platform observability tools (Azure Monitor, Log Analytics/KQL). Self-motivation and self-sufficiency requiring minimal guidance to achieve technical objectives. Excellent communication skills and comfort collaborating with diverse technical teams. Continuous alignment with and adherence to AnaVation’s core values. Location/Hours: This position is fully remote and can be performed from anywhere within the continental United States. Regardless of location, this position requires full-time support during core Eastern Time business hours to align with our Government customer in Washington, DC. This position may require support outside of core business hours for outages, updates/upgrades, and other needs. Preferred Qualifications: Experience with Azure Government and/or AWS GovCloud/C2S/SC2S Active Secret or Top Secret clearance Azure certifications (Azure Solutions Architect Expert, Administrator, and/or Developer) Kubernetes certifications (CKA, CKAD, CKS) IaC/DevOps certifications (Hashicorp/Terraform) AWS certifications (AWS Certified Solutions Architect Professional, DevOps Engineer Professional, Developer, and/or SysOps Administrator) Familiarity with cloud cost optimization strategies Benefits Generous cost sharing for medical insurance for the employee and dependents 100% company paid dental insurance for employees and dependents 100% company paid long-term and short-term disability insurance 100% company paid vision insurance for employees and dependents 401k plan with generous match and 100% immediate vesting Competitive Pay Generous paid leave and holiday package Tuition and training reimbursement Life and AD&D Insurance About AnaVation AnaVation is the leader in solving the most complex technical challenges for collection and processing in the U.S. Federal Intelligence Community. We are a US owned company headquartered in Chantilly, Virginia. We deliver groundbreaking research with advanced software and systems engineering that provides an information advantage to contribute to the mission and operational success of our customers. We offer complex challenges, a top-notch work environment, and a world-class, collaborative team. If you want to grow your career and make a difference while doing it, AnaVation is the perfect fit for you! AnaVation is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected Veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law. Please note: The listed salary range reflects our market-based compensation structure. Final compensation will depend on business needs, local market conditions, internal equity, and the selected candidate’s skills, education, and experience.

Plan and execute database cutover, rollback, production go-live, and post-migration stabilization activities. Independently execute migration runbooks across multiple migration waves within a Migration Factory environment. Collaborate with application, infrastructure, cloud, and engineering teams to ensure smooth migration execution. Knowledge of database schema conversion, data validation, reconciliation, and migration testing. Strong database administration, troubleshooting, and performance-tuning skills. Experience with Shell, Python, or PowerShell scripting and automation. Ability to independently manage end-to-end database migration activities, including cutover and rollback. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills. Good-to-Have Skills Experience with SingleStore database migration. Experience working in large-scale Migration Factory environments. Exposure to database modernization and cloud migration initiatives. Experience with migration planning, migration waves, production deployment, and post-migration support. Candidate Profile Hands-on database professional with enterprise migration experience. Comfortable working across source and target database platforms. Able to manage migration activities independently and coordinate with cross-functional teams. Focused on data accuracy, minimal downtime, performance, and operational stability.
